description: This file defines data structures, constants, and types related to MCP (Management Control Plane) server configuration, process management, status, tools, resources, and JSON-RPC communication protocols within the MCP system.

classes.name: MCPServerConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration settings for an MCP server, including connection details, transport, environment, and runtime info.

classes.name: MCPProcess
classes.description: Represents a running MCP server process, including configuration, command execution, and I/O streams.

classes.name: MCPServerStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible MCP server statuses: stopped, starting, running, error.

classes.name: MCPServerInfo
classes.description: Contains information about an MCP server instance for status and listing purposes.

classes.name: MCPTool
classes.description: Defines an MCP tool with name, description, input schema, and output schema.

classes.name: MCPResource
classes.description: Defines an MCP resource with URI, name, description, and MIME type.

classes.name: MCPManifest
classes.description: Represents the capabilities of an MCP server, including tools, resources, and version.

classes.name: MCPRequest
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request to an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC notification to an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPResponse
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response from an MCP server.

classes.name: MCPError
classes.description: Represents an error in the MCP protocol.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: Contains client identification information for MCP.

classes.name: MCPToolsListResponse
classes.description: Response structure for listing MCP tools.

classes.name: MCPResourcesListResponse
classes.description: Response structure for listing MCP resources.

classes.name: MCPToolDefinition
classes.description: Definition of an MCP tool as per protocol.

classes.name: MCPResourceDefinition
classes.description: Definition of an MCP resource as per protocol.
